page_title: BOU 1-1 BUR | Bournemouth v Burnley 20/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Andoni Iraola prepares a substitution. Alejandro Jimenez is replaced by Amine Adli (Bournemouth).
90+2' That will be all from Marcus Tavernier who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Alex Scott (Bournemouth).
90+2' Bournemouth can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Armando Broja (Burnley) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Ryan Christie and scores magnificently from close range into the left side of the goal. 1:1.
90' The ball goes behind for a corner. Burnley will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
86' Burnley have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

86' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Lucas Pires (Burnley). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. The linesman makes the right call and Burnley will have a corner.
85' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.

85' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The linesman points to the corner flag, Bournemouth are going to take it.
82' Here is a change. Lesley Ugochukwu is going off and Scott Parker gives the last tactical orders to Mike Tresor Ndayishimiye (Burnley).
81' Great teamplay by Bournemouth as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
79' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
77' Marcus Edwards (Burnley) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jaidon Anthony.
77' Scott Parker has decided to make a change. Oliver Sonne (Burnley) replaces Kyle Walker.
76' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
75' Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
74' The referee allows time for a substitution. David Brooks will be replaced by Ryan Christie (Bournemouth).
74' David Brooks (Bournemouth) picks up a yellow card.
73' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 13:0.
72' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
71' A cross from Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

67' 1 - 0 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a great shot into the bottom right corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Martin Dubravka, so the score changes to 1:0.
67' Armando Broja (Burnley) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
66' Substitution. Jacob Bruun Larsen makes way for Loum Tchaouna (Burnley).
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Armando Broja (Burnley) comes onto the pitch for Zian Flemming.
64' A cross from a corner kick by Burnley is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
64' Andoni Iraola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) replacing Justin Kluivert.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Enes Unal (Bournemouth) replaces Evanilson.
61' David Brooks (Bournemouth) misses an absolute sitter after connecting with a cross inside the penalty box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
61' Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
59' Neat passing move from Bournemouth in order to create new attacking opportunities.
57' A pass lands at the feet of David Brooks (Bournemouth) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
57' The ball is cleared after Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

56' David Brooks (Bournemouth) meets a cross inside the box and heads it goalwards. Unfortunately for him, he sends the ball narrowly over the crossbar. What a chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
56' Ball possession – 71:29.

54' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
53' Bournemouth control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
51' Good movement by Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
48' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
47' The Bournemouth players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
43' A goal, which was scored by Jaidon Anthony (Burnley), was disallowed due to offside.
43' The fouls committed statistics – 5:7.
40' Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
38' Zian Flemming (Burnley) is punished with the yellow card.
37' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
36' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
35' Bournemouth take a short corner kick.
35' Bournemouth failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
34' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
33' An attempted cross from Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) is cleared.
33' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
31' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
30' The shots on goal statistics – 0:0.
29' Evanilson (Bournemouth) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
28' David Brooks (Bournemouth) tries to find Evanilson, but he puts too much power on the through ball.

27' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the right post by a whisker. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
27' Zian Flemming (Burnley) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Chris Kavanagh blows for a foul.
26' The total number of attempts is 4:0.
26' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
24' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
23' Bournemouth keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
20' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) heads on.

19' Antoine Semenyo sends a slide-rule pass into the feet of Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth), who without a second thought fires a shot in on goal from mid-range which only goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
17' The Bournemouth players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
15' Burnley are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
14' 71:29 – this is the current ball possession ratio.

13' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
13' A quickly taken corner by Bournemouth.
12' This shall not pass! Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
11' Evanilson (Bournemouth) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.

10' What a chance that is! David Brooks (Bournemouth) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
9' Bournemouth enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
8' David Brooks (Bournemouth) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

6' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by David Brooks (Bournemouth), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
3' Bournemouth seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

1' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Djordje Petrovic. This effort really didn't trouble him.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Burnley will take the kick-off.
